## Summary
- add a macOS Host compatibility observation requiring stream, input, and reconnect evidence to be correlated to the same packaged Host PID/session
- update README/runbook/TEST guidance so the open compatibility gate stays explicitly conservative
- regenerate the latest blocked Mac16,8 compatibility summary with the new missing runtime-session requirement

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_macos_hardware_compatibility -v
- python3 -m py_compile tools/vibescreen_evidence/macos_hardware_compatibility.py tools/tests/test_macos_hardware_compatibility.py
- make phase0-stable-release-gate
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m vibescreen_evidence.macos_hardware_compatibility docs/changes/2026-08-21-host-signing-tcc-preflight/evidence/2026-08-31-macos-host-compatibility-current-base-codex-task-blocked/macos-hardware-compatibility.json --output docs/changes/2026-08-21-host-signing-tcc-preflight/evidence/2026-08-31-macos-host-compatibility-current-base-codex-task-blocked/macos-hardware-compatibility-gate.json (expected exit 1, blocked)
- git diff --check

No Host GUI, swift run, TCC prompt/reset, adb reverse, or merge-admin action was used.
title: Harden macOS Host compatibility runtime gate
